title: OasisFx sprite frames preset v1
description: Data-only description of frame-by-frame animations cut from a sprite sheet, which OasisFx turns into a Godot 4 SpriteFrames resource. Generated from addons/oasis_fx/src/core/sprite_frames_spec.gd; the GDScript validator is authoritative and also enforces the cross-field rules in docs/animation_format.md.

asset_type.description: Asset kind: "sprite_frames" for frame-by-frame animations from a sprite sheet.

id.description: Stable identifier; also the output file name (<id>.tres). Lowercase snake_case.

description.description: What the sprite animations are for.

author.description: Who made the preset (person or AI tool).

texture.description: The sprite sheet image in the project, res://… (png, webp, jpg).

source_author.description: Who drew or generated the sprite sheet.

source_license.description: License of the sprite sheet, e.g. "CC0", "own work".

columns.description: Number of frames per row of the sheet.

rows.description: Number of rows of the sheet.

frame_count.description: Frames actually used in the sheet when the last row is not full; 0 = columns × rows.

margin_px.description: Empty border around the whole sheet in pixels [x, y].

separation_px.description: Empty space between neighboring frames in pixels [x, y].

animations.description: Named animations, 1 to 32 (e.g. idle, walk, burn).

name.description: Animation name used with AnimatedSprite2D.play("name"). Lowercase snake_case.

frames.description: Sheet cells to show, in order: 0 is the top-left frame, counting along each row. A cell may repeat.

loop.description: true = repeats; false = stops on the last frame (AnimatedSprite2D emits animation_finished).
